slides.headline: Google just ranked your LinkedIn post
slides.subhead: Platform properties now tracked in Search Console this month

slides.headline: First line is your headline now
slides.body: Put your target keyword *front*. That shapes the title Google indexes. Skip the keyword work and posts sit unranked while competitors outrank you in the same results.

slides.headline: Same text, four platforms
slides.body: Repost across LinkedIn, X, Threads, and Facebook. Near-zero extra work for four rankable properties instead of one. LinkedIn domain authority: 99. Company blogs don't get near that.

slides.headline: Video descriptions stop being hashtag dumps
slides.body: *Full transcripts* instead. That's what search engines and AI models actually parse.

slides.quote: None of this replaces your website. That's still where trust gets built and deals close.
slides.subhead: The real value is what that visibility feeds next.

slides.headline: Your first move
slides.body: Pick one platform you post daily. Rewrite the first line of your next post as a headline built around the keyword you'd want it ranked for.
